tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Incorporate Daria Willowdoodle’s household profile and her monthly support contribution for her mother Patrice Dewspindle into retirement cash-flow assumptions.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents, and major recent or expected life events.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record as applicable.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to incorporate this household profile and family support assumption by 2024-04-03.

tickets.title: Prepare retirement income timing projections
tickets.text: Prepare side-by-side cash flow projections comparing Daria’s planned separation from Clockwork Clover Systems with working two additional quarters, including pension timing, Social Security delay assumptions, portfolio withdrawals, cash reserves, and estimated tax withholding.
tickets.evidence: For the retirement income timing comparison, Daria requested side-by-side cash flow projections comparing her planned separation from Clockwork Clover Systems with working two additional quarters.

tickets.title: Review pension benefit election options
tickets.text: Review the Clockwork Clover Systems pension single-life and joint-survivor options and assist Daria in selecting an election for the retirement transition.
tickets.evidence: the Clockwork Clover Systems pension packet shows a single-life option and a joint-survivor option, and Daria has not selected an election for the retirement transition. Further review of the pension benefit election is needed by 2024-08-30.

tickets.title: Obtain retiree medical and HSA transition details
tickets.text: Obtain the rate sheet, eligibility terms, and HSA transfer instructions for any possible employer retiree medical bridge and update the insurance and HSA transition records.
tickets.evidence: Daria described a possible employer retiree medical bridge, but the rate sheet, eligibility terms, and HSA transfer instructions were not available during the meeting. Those retiree medical and HSA transition details are needed by 2024-04-05.

tickets.title: Reconcile 401(k) source balances
tickets.text: Reconcile the Roth 401(k) source balance from Daria’s latest Clockwork Clover Systems plan statement with the custodian feed used in the planning file, which shows no Roth source for the same plan.
tickets.evidence: Daria’s latest plan statement shows a Roth 401(k) source balance, while the custodian feed used in the planning file shows no Roth source for the same plan. Reconciliation of the 401(k) source balance is needed by 2024-03-22.

tickets.title: Review client equity awards and vesting status
tickets.text: Complete the employer stock and RSU concentration analysis for Daria’s Clockwork Clover Systems equity, including vested RSUs and company stock exposure in other accounts, to determine if it exceeds her stated single-stock comfort level.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete the employer stock and RSU concentration analysis by 2024-04-12.

tickets.title: Address beneficiary update service correction
tickets.text: Address the Velvet Acorn Custody online beneficiary update failure for the joint taxable account after the system rejected Eli’s date-of-birth verification.
tickets.evidence: Daria reported that the Velvet Acorn Custody online beneficiary update for the joint taxable account failed after the system rejected Eli’s date-of-birth verification. The agreed follow-up is to address the beneficiary update service correction by 2024-03-20.
